[{{{org_name}}}] Master MoU renewal reminder — 180 days
Hello {{{contact_first_name}}},
As we look ahead, I wanted to flag that the Master MoU between Wadhwani Grants and {{{org_name}}} is due to expire on {{{mou_expiry_date}}} — about 180 days from now.
There's plenty of time, and nothing urgent to do today. I'd simply like to start the conversation about renewing our partnership and what the next chapter could look like together.
View MoU & renewal: {{{portal_url}}}
I'll reach out to find a good time to talk. As always, you can reach me at [grants.support@wadhwanifoundation.org](mailto:grants.support@wadhwanifoundation.org).
Warm regards, {{{pl_name}}} Wadhwani Grants
© {{{year}}} Wadhwani Charitable Foundation. All rights reserved.
